# U6: Understand a goal and its change history

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `NOTES`, `GOAL-PAGE`, `CHANGE-LOG`, `ATTENTION`, `REBASELINE`
- **Budget:** 3 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `errors`, `budget` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Santiago, at `/goals?scope=all&attention=1` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U6

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Santiago owns the Kafka migration: a milestone, off track, with late stages and a worsening trend.
- Open a fresh browser as Santiago (`santiago`).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&attention=1` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the grow (`.grow`) is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the grow (`.grow`).
- **Check:** The goal’s summary bar shows.
- _Note:_ The summary bar says off track and how many stages are late; Why opens with the reason (the scorecard, 5 Nov).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `await p.locator('.goal-bar[data-tone=off] .bar-status.off').isVisible() && /^[1-9]\d*$/.test((await p.locator('.goal-bar .sc-late .sc-value').innerText()).trim()) && (await p.locator('.why-block .why-text').innerText()).length > 10`. Else it says: off track and its reasons are not shown.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “goal page”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Check-ins, comments and changes are one stream; Changes shows only the changes.
- **Step.** Press the “Changes N” link in the history filters in the history (`#history .history-filters`).
- **Step.** Press the “Show …change” button in the History section.
- **Check:** (`logged`) the ins in the diffs (`.diffs ins`) is visible (else: a change does not show its before and after).
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`progress`) the stagelist (`.stagelist`) is visible (else: the stages are not shown).
- _Note:_ Anyone can comment; it goes straight into the goal's activity, logged like every other save.
- Press the “Add a comment” button.
- **Step.** Type “The vendor confirmed their December date holds.” into the “Add a comment” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Post comment” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Comments N” link in the history filters in the history (`#history .history-filters`).
- **Check:** “The vendor confirmed their December date holds.” is shown (else: the comment shows in the activity).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.some((c) => c.actorId === 'santiago' && c.goalId === 'fresh-kafka' && c.diffs.some((d) => /December date/.test(d.to)))`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the comment is not in the change log.
- Go to `/goals/ns-ai` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Target changed in week 20: 60% → 80%” is shown (else: the re-baseline is explained on the chart).
- Close this browser.

How to read these lines: [the journeys](../../core/journeys.md#how-to-read-a-journeys-steps).
